label: All three on one board
about: Top: Black's three-space jump on the edge, C7 and G7; White splits it in the middle at E7. Centre: Black plays E5, the centre of the board. Bottom: Black's knight's move, D3 and F2; White plays between at E3, the mirror of E2. ← steps back.

label: Three-space jump on the edge
about: Black's two stones on the third line, C3 and G3, have three empty points between them. The middle one, E3, is the point of symmetry: White splits them there. ← shows the position before.

label: Between a knight's move
about: Black's knight's move, C6 and D4. The two points between them, C5 and D5, are mirror images around its centre. White plays between at D5. ← shows the position before.

label: The centre of the board
about: E5 is the centre of the 9x9 board, the point of symmetry for the whole board. Black takes it, then answers each White move with its mirror image through E5 (mirror go). ← steps back.
